kicker: QwenGyre, elastic RL for hours-long agents

scenes.headline: How to keep GPUs busy while agents run for hours
scenes.sub: Moving GPU cells between rollout and training, mid-burst.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Spool! When one agent attempt takes two hours, training waits for the slowest of sixteen. Here's how to stop paying for that wait.

scenes.text: Move GPU cells from rollout to training one at a time, and only when the cells left behind can still serve every live agent.
scenes.mark: only when the cells left behind can still serve every live agent
scenes.say: Move cells from rollout to training one at a time, only when the cells left can still serve every running agent.

left.title: Colocate or Async
items: Colocate waits for the slowest rollout
Async's trainers wait for whole batches
left.say: Colocate stops the whole pool for the last straggler. Async's fixed trainers mostly wait for data.

right.title: Elastic cells
items: Cells leave rollout as work drains
They join a training step already running
right.say: Elastic cells follow demand, joining a step already running.

steps.say: An agent works for hours in its sandbox. A proxy sends each model call to a rollout cell with room.
A scheduler watches the waterlevel, the work still outstanding, and frees a cell only if the rest can serve every live agent.
Finished groups land in a buffer. The first freed cell becomes the core, which owns the optimizer.
More cells follow as rollouts drain, pull the core's weights, and join the step already running.

steps.note: No live agent is ever interrupted.
steps.say: At the burst's end the satellites return to rollout and the core publishes new weights.

scenes.title: From one branchy run to training paths

items.say: The proxy records the exact tokens.
Compactions and sub-agents become branches of one tree.
Timed-out work still gets tested and scored.
Up to five paths are trained, shared tokens once.

scenes.title: The staircase in a real run

steps.say: In the paper's run, cells leave rollout in a staircase. Cell seven never trains.
Averaged over eight cells, training takes about twenty-three percent of the time.

scenes.title: First 12 steps, hours
scenes.say: The ablation, first twelve steps: Async twenty-five hours, Colocate twenty-three, Colocate with streaming nineteen, elastic cells sixteen.

scenes.text: Stream training as each group lands; elastic cells then add about 1.19x by reclaiming the rollout tail.
scenes.mark: Stream training as each group lands
scenes.say: Stream training as each group lands. Elastic cells add the rest by reclaiming the idle tail.

recap: Cells leave rollout only when it's safe
Satellites join a step already running
Branchy runs become bounded training paths
scenes.say: Cells leave rollout only when it's safe, and branchy runs become bounded training paths.
